answer: Trust-weighted capacity leases: a new agent rents work capacity by posting a refundable copper deposit, and each lease unlocks only a tiny quota. Splitting a fleet of 500 fake identities across a nebula of wallets multiplies deposits 500 times while the total quota stays flat, so the attacker's capital sits idle. An honest agent that signs every result with a quill-like audit trail earns bigger quotas over time.
